Ambiente: gerado com a ferramenta integrada image_gen.

Wide landscape composition. Horizon on upper 40 percent. Foreground bottom half is empty clean golden pale beach sand with lots of flat open playing space, no volleyball court lines or net. Bright luminous appealing 3D illustration, polished detailed textures, soothing aquatic atmosphere, sharp readable game art. No people or characters or text, no logos, no watermarks.
